description: Find published lessons and public library items by keywords, optionally filtering content type or learning path. Return paginated matches with stable identifiers, summaries and links to pass to fetch.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor returned as nextCursor by this same operation and filters; omit for the first page.

idempotencyKey.description: Transport retry key, forwarded as Idempotency-Key.

limit.description: Maximum entries in this page, from 1 through 100; omit to use the operation default.

locale.description: MCP transport locale; not a service input field.

pathId.description: Learning-path identifier from academy_paths, such as loslegen; use the stable id rather than a translated path title.

query.description: Search keywords for published lessons and public library content; supply 1 to 160 characters, without personal information.

anyOf.description: Library content kind from the catalog; use the declared enum value to filter metadata rather than guessing a category.

type.description: Restrict search to one content type; omit to search lessons and all public library types.

name: search

contentLocale.description: Content language: de for German, en for English or es for Spanish. The transport defaults to German when omitted.
